instructions: This package is the CREED OS web application built with Svelte 5, SvelteKit 2, Tailwind CSS 4, and the WAY Design System. Enforce: 1) Svelte 5 runes ($props, $state, $derived, $effect) exclusively, 2) WAY 2.1 Architectural Radius System: 0px (rounded-none) for structural/technical surfaces, 4px (rounded-sm) for controls/content surfaces, 8px (rounded-md) for expressive media frames; strictly prohibit 12px+ bubbly curves, 3) Semantic OKLCH tokens only (no ad-hoc hex codes), 4) Strict 8pt spacing rhythm, 5) Full interactive state coverage.

rules.rule: Every Svelte component must use Svelte 5 runes. Do not use legacy Svelte 4 'export let' or reactive declarations '$:'. Use $props(), $state(), and $derived().

Adhere strictly to the WAY 2.1 Architectural Radius System: 0px (rounded-none) for structural/technical surfaces (tables, assessment question frames, studio grids), 4px (rounded-sm) for controls and content surfaces (buttons, inputs, cards, dialogs, nav items), and 8px (rounded-md) for expressive media frames. Never use 12px+ bubbly consumer curves (rounded-lg, rounded-xl, rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl, pill buttons) except for circular avatars (rounded-full).
Do not hardcode hex color values (e.g. #03080e, #38bdf8). Use semantic CSS variable tokens: var(--surface-canvas), var(--surface-raised), var(--text-primary), var(--accent-cyan), etc.
Never expose raw psychometric parameters (theta, SE, 3PL a/b/c, discrimination, information curves) to students or parents. Display growth-oriented narrative language instead.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) must implement full state coverage: default, hover, active, focus-visible, and disabled states.
